Bettina, the official change of ownership was **November 3, 2025**. Moss's Coastal digest from Sunday 11/2 says the account "changes hands tomorrow, 2025-11-03."

Your own cutover recap (Dec 8, 2025) adds a second date. You kept running day-to-day operations until Nov 21, and Kwame Adjei-Rowe fully took over on **November 22, 2025**. If your tracker wants the date Kwame actually started working the account, use Nov 22. For the official handoff, use Nov 3.
